title: eh_os_contract graph.v1
description: A contract or a domain as a graph of facts: what is declared, with nothing of how it is drawn, which pictures it is shown in, or what the log holds. Nodes are grouped by kind and relations by type, every kind and type present; a relation goes from its source to its target and its type reads in that direction. Ids are opaque and unique in a document: a reader joins on them and never takes them apart. Every id resolves to a node of the same document, except those described as a reference into another document.

default.description: Its default, redacted as the exported model is.

personal_of.description: The name of the field holding the id of the person whose personal data this is.

issued_by.description: The id of the external that gives it its value: its own, or its entity's identity's.

kept.description: What keeps its value about a person, where something does: log_sealed, an event's personal data, encrypted in the log with its subject's key, which erasing the subject destroys; log_clear, an event's pointer at its subject, in the log in the clear; rows_forgotten, a read model's personal data, in its rows, which it forgets when the subject is erased. idempotency.description: What tells a second delivery from a first, and who keeps it harmless.

latency.description: How long the system takes to answer, as the domain declares it.
